name: n4_read_slots
description: Read all slots of one component as {name, type, value, status}. Status complexes add status_ok/status_null; a Status slot's omitted value or status takes the type default. value_display carries the station's display string; a complex the reader cannot decode (e.g. a Modbus FlexAddress) returns that display string as value. elapsed_ms is the load time. A slot that is itself a baja:Status also adds status_flags, the names of the flags set; status_ok is false when any is set. A station leaves out a declared (frozen) property still at its default; those are listed after the loaded slots from the type contract (the station's type registry, read once per session), each marked default: true with the contract's default value, or value null and a note when the contract gives no default value (e.g. a component default such as proxyExt): never an invented value. defaults_note says when a type contract could not be read, and names a declared default that could not be decoded (left out).
